title: Polyglot or Not? Measuring Multilingual Encyclopedic Knowledge in Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing factual recall accuracy using Contrastive Knowledge Assessment (CKA) on cloze statements translated across 20 different languages, including an analysis of performance disparities between English and non-English texts, as well as between Latin and Cyrillic scripts.

Tagging subject entities with their corresponding geographic continents using an LLM, and then comparing the model's factual recall accuracy across these different geographic locations (e.g., Asian vs. European locations).

Tagging biographical subject entities with their birth gender (male/female/other) and using a chi-squared test for independence to compare the model's factual recall accuracy on facts about male versus female subjects.
